clock_domains.name: clk_ref
clock_domains.description: Shared 100 MHz reference; PLL input, CSR/host + LTSM domain, TX word clock.

clock_domains.name: clk_fwd_rx
clock_domains.description: Received forwarded clock, divided to the RX word rate. Mesochronous to clk_ref (same source both dies) - phase-only FIFO.

clock_domains.name: clk_sb
clock_domains.description: Always-on sideband clock - alive before any mainband training.

signals.name: rx_pdata
signals.meaning: Per-lane deserialized RX word in the forwarded-clock domain. Garbage until the LTSM completes MBTRAIN.

signals.name: tx_pdata
signals.meaning: Per-lane TX word toward the serializer, clk_ref word domain.

signals.name: sb_rxd
signals.meaning: Sideband serial RX (UCIe-style always-on channel for parameter exchange/training messages).

signals.name: lane_repair_sel
signals.meaning: Lane remap/repair select (single-lane-shift, UCIe-like). Changed only in MBINIT repair.

signals.name: txrx_imp_code
signals.meaning: TX driver impedance compensation code from MBINIT calibration.

signals.name: pll_locked
signals.meaning: PLL lock detector; gates leaving RESET. Synchronized into clk_ref.

signals.name: rstn_por
signals.meaning: Chip POR, async assert; release synchronized per domain.

signals.name: en_afe
signals.meaning: Master mainband AFE enable (PLL, drivers, receivers). Sideband AFE is always on.

cdc_points.notes: Phase-only elastic FIFO after the deskew aligner (mesochronous: both dies share the reference, no ppm drift).
Sideband packets cross into the LTSM domain through a small message FIFO.

reset_sequence.action: POR asserts asynchronously; mainband disabled, sideband logic held in SBINIT
POR release synchronized into each domain (2ff per domain)

power_sequence.action: Sideband up (always-on): SBINIT parameter exchange over sb_rxd/sb_txd
MBTRAIN: per-lane deskew training, then ACTIVE
